mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id FROM gis_analysis_history WHERE snapshot_token = #{snapshotToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gis_analysis_history ( snapshot_token, title, center_lon, center_lat, radius_m, criterion, intersecting_count, inside_count, partial_count, outside_excluded_count, geometry_unavailable_count, distinct_building_count, merged_duplicate_count, reported_total, fetched_features, fetched_pages, reported_pages, is_complete, source_provider, source_layer, source_crs, source_notice, analyzed_at, saved_at ) VALUES ( #{row.snapshotToken}, #{row.title}, #{row.centerLon}, #{row.centerLat}, #{row.radiusM}, #{row.criterion}, #{row.intersectingCount}, #{row.insideCount}, #{row.partialCount}, #{row.outsideExcludedCount}, #{row.geometryUnavailableCount}, #{row.distinctBuildingCount}, #{row.mergedDuplicateCount}, #{row.reportedTotal,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{row.fetchedFeatures}, #{row.fetchedPages}, #{row.reportedPages,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{row.complete}, #{row.sourceProvider}, #{row.sourceLayer}, #{row.sourceCrs}, #{row.sourceNotice}, #{row.analyzedAt}, #{row.savedAt} )

INSERT INTO gis_analysis_incomplete_reason (analysis_id, seq, reason_code, message) VALUES
(#{r.analysisId}, #{r.seq}, #{r.reasonCode}, #{r.message})

INSERT INTO gis_analysis_building ( analysis_id, seq, building_key, bd_mgt_sn, building_name, building_sub_name, sido, sigungu, eupmyeon, road_name, building_number, ground_floor_raw, ground_floor_count, relation, distance_m, center_inside, has_holes, geometry ) VALUES
(#{b.analysisId}, #{b.seq}, #{b.buildingKey}, #{b.bdMgtSn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.buildingName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.buildingSubName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.sido,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.sigungu,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.eupmyeon,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.roadName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.buildingNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.groundFloorRaw,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.groundFloorCount,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{b.relation}, #{b.distanceM}, #{b.centerInside}, #{b.hasHoles}, #{b.geometry})
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id, snapshot_token, title, center_lon, center_lat, radius_m, criterion, intersecting_count, inside_count, partial_count, outside_excluded_count, geometry_unavailable_count, distinct_building_count, merged_duplicate_count, reported_total, fetched_features, fetched_pages, reported_pages, is_complete, source_provider, source_layer, source_crs, source_notice, analyzed_at, saved_at FROM gis_analysis_history WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
SELECT analysis_id, seq, reason_code, message FROM gis_analysis_incomplete_reason WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT analysis_id, seq, building_key, bd_mgt_sn, building_name, building_sub_name, sido, sigungu, eupmyeon, road_name, building_number, ground_floor_raw, ground_floor_count, relation, distance_m, center_inside, has_holes, geometry FROM gis_analysis_building WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT COUNT(ground_floor_count) AS with_data, COUNT(*) - COUNT(ground_floor_count) AS without_data, MIN(ground_floor_count) AS min_floor, MAX(ground_floor_count) AS max_floor, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count), 0) AS floor_sum, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2), 0) AS bucket_1_to_2, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count BETWEEN 3 AND 5), 0) AS bucket_3_to_5, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count BETWEEN 6 AND 10), 0) AS bucket_6_to_10, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count BETWEEN 11 AND 20), 0) AS bucket_11_to_20, COALESCE(SUM(ground_floor_count >= 21), 0) AS bucket_21_plus FROM gis_analysis_building WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
